framework: Rhode Island state academic standards: Health Education
subject: Health Education

source.publisher: Rhode Island state education agency (machine-readable via Common Standards Project / ASN)

units.title: Students will understand the concepts related to health promotion and disease prevention as a foundation for a healthy life

topics.title: Students will understand the concepts related to health promotion and disease prevention as a foundation for a healthy life

subtopics.title: Students will understand the concepts related to health promotion and disease prevention as a foundation for a healthy life (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: Describe relationships between personal health behaviors and individual well being.
Identify indicators of mental, emotional, social and physical health during childhood.
Describe the basic structure and functions of the human body systems.
Describe how physical, social, emotional and family environments influence personal health.

subtopics.title: Students will understand the concepts related to health promotion and disease prevention as a foundation for a healthy life (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: Identify common health problems of children.
Identify health problems that should be detected and treated early.
Explain how childhood injuries and illnesses can be prevented or treated.

units.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to access valid health information and health promoting products and services

topics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to access valid health information and health promoting products and services

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to access valid health information and health promoting products and services (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: Identify characteristics of valid health information and health-promoting products and services.
Demonstrate the ability to locate resources from home, school and community that provide valid health information.
Explain how media influences the selection of health information, products and services.
Demonstrate the ability to locate school and community health helpers.

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to access valid health information and health promoting products and services (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: Describe the relationship between health products and services and money.
Identify situations requiring professional health services.
Identify different kinds of health providers.

units.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to practice health-enhancing behaviors and reduce health risks

topics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to practice health-enhancing behaviors and reduce health risks

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to practice health-enhancing behaviors and reduce health risks (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: Identify responsible health behaviors.
Identify personal health needs and health habits.
Compare behaviors that are safe to those that are risky or harmful.
Demonstrate strategies to improve or maintain personal health.

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to practice health-enhancing behaviors and reduce health risks (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: Develop injury prevention and management strategies for personal health.
Identify and demonstrate ways to avoid and reduce threatening situations.
Recognize stressful situations and identify appropriate ways to manage them.

outcomes.text: Demonstrate awareness of the influence of culture upon personal health behaviors.

units.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to use interpersonal communication skills to enhance health

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to use interpersonal communication skills to enhance health (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: Distinguish between verbal and non-verbal communication.
